title: No teacher; cousin Peter and Charlie learned to read
summary: He never took lessons though Peter lived next door; Charlie first played by head and Peter taught him to read after New York.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: But you never had any teacher?
No, never went to no teacher. Of course, I could have... I could have went right there to my cousin Peter for it, that matter, see.
Well, there, there. And Wooden Barth was.
Now, Charlie... You take my... Excuse me, cousin y'all. Charlie... Charlie came up my head, too.
See, Charlie... Charlie came up my head, and when they went to New York, well, Peter then commenced to learn Charlie how to read a little.
You see. But Charlie first started off, he started by head, too. In fact, most all of them, old musicians and winders, they all practically play up my head.
